acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Giants family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Stone Giant, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Chain-Megalith Orbit Controller (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: House-sized, with boulder-scale arm ridges, a cliff-face brow, carved skin runes, and a megalith suspended from an iron chain whose pivot hardware remains fully visible.

Signature mechanic: Megalith Orbit: the Stone Giant anchors the chain around a boulder-ridged forearm and walks a measured circle, swinging the megalith through a wide outer ring while the space beside its cliff-face brow remains calm. Reversing direction requires the Giant to plant the megalith, step across the chain, and expose the anchor wrist.
battlefieldDuty: Replace simple linear sweeps with a moving circular exclusion zone, using a chained megalith to divide the arena and pull displaced terrain into a deliberate orbit.
constructionDimensions: Body geology becomes volcanic but remains load-bearing: clinker shelves, basalt plates, charred pine roots, obsidian chain guards, and cooled lava crust form over recognizable hide and stone growth.
Motion and surface behavior expose heat cycling through opening crust vents, directional ash falls, steam where runoff crosses hot seams, and dark cooling plates that contract between attacks.
counterplay: Enter the calm inner radius, cross behind the planted megalith during reversal, and strike or bind the exposed wrist anchor before the chain lifts into the opposite orbit. Affinity signal: A basalt joint opens to a bright heat sink after committed movement; striking the cooling seam or redirecting shoulder runoff into it fractures the loaded plate.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only fire treatment without volcanic materials, vent cycles, and heat-driven surface change
Glow-only fire treatment without load-bearing crust or exposed cooling seams
Featureless flame bodies that erase humanoid anatomy and lived-in geology
Uniform lava coating that hides chain pivots, heels, and rune anchors
identityInvariants: Humanlike proportions scaled upward with a heavy brow, thick limbs, dense bone, and a slight stoop that communicates the body's own weight.
Stone gray, granite blue-gray, earth brown, moss green, glacier white, and warm amber eyes remain the family palette without requiring an elemental origin.
Rough hide, raw stone, moss, lichen, pine, iron chain, and rope accumulate as bodily geology and oversized practical tools.
Chains, standing-stone jewelry, skin runes, and whole trees function as ornament at a scale that stays legible from the arena.
Raw scale and geological coverage escalate together until the Sovereign carries a valley, but every form retains recognizable humanoid load paths and slow committed motion.
telegraph: Iron chain rises link by gate-sized link, the megalith scrapes a bright circular track, and runes along one forearm align toward the intended orbit before the first swing.
